note: Previews captured on the artifact screen, replayed with the plant data of the version they were taken on. An Evolution preview lists its selections in selection order with the cell, the candidates, the draw interval and whether the plant was placed, and add_order is the recorded plant-add order; no placement effect drew. A Devolution preview, marked with its artifact, lists the draw interval of each of its shuffles: the captures record the draws but not the lists. No process or account data.
